pack.topic: Plinth Beam vs Lintel Beam: Structural Role & Spatial Differences in Coimbatore Residential Construction
pack.source_script_insight: The source video uses a concise spatial cutaway visual to contrast two essential mechanical components operating at different heights (bottom rotating crankshaft vs top lobed camshafts) linked by vertical timing elements. This concept translates directly into structural building elements: contrasting lower structural support (Plinth Beam) with upper aperture support (Lintel Beam) connected by concrete columns.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In Coimbatore's suburban house construction (e.g., Saravanampatti, Vadavalli, Thudiyalur), plot owners frequently mistake the roles of lower plinth beams and upper lintel beams, leading to inadequate reinforcement planning for wall openings and foundation settlement.
pack.core_takeaway: Plinth beams at ground level tie footings together to prevent uneven settlement, while lintel beams above openings safely transfer wall loads around doors and windows.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
PRODUCTION SHOT LIST FOR OLIVETREE BUILDERS (COIMBATORE ONLY). EXACTLY 10 SECONDS TOTAL, EXACTLY 7 DISTINCT SCENES. PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION REAL FOOTAGE ONLY (90%+ real video look). Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. Real active residential construction site in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, featuring red gravel soil, wire-cut red clay bricks, grey Portland cement plaster, and steel rebar, under bright tropical afternoon daylight.

[SCENE 1: 0.0s - 1.4s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Active residential construction plot in Vadavalli, Coimbatore.
FOREGROUND: A residential house structure under construction, red clay brick walls partially raised.
BACKGROUND: Clear blue skies and neighboring coconut palm treetops in Coimbatore.
CAMERA: Low-angle eye-level shot tilting slightly upward, 24mm wide angle, handheld gimbal motion.
ACTION: Camera moves slightly revealing the structural skeleton with ground-level concrete shuttering and lintel level beams.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Minimalist yellow outline box with text 'PLINTH vs LINTEL?'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'பிளின்த் பீம், லிண்டல் பீம்... வித்தியாசம் தெரியுமா?'

[SCENE 2: 1.4s - 2.8s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Foundation trench level at the same site.
FOREGROUND: Smooth cured grey concrete plinth beam running horizontally across red Coimbatore gravel soil.
CAMERA: Ground-level tracking shot sliding along the side of the plinth beam, 35mm lens, sharp texture focus.
ACTION: Sunlight glints off the concrete surface as camera moves smooth and steady.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Small clean white callout label '1. PLINTH BEAM'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'கீழே உள்ள பிளின்த் பீம்...'

[SCENE 3: 2.8s - 4.2s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Foundation column junction.
FOREGROUND: Concrete plinth beam joining vertical RCC column starter with rebar ties.
CAMERA: Static medium shot at knee height, 35mm lens feel.
ACTION: Subtle graphic arrow overlay illuminates indicating outward force distribution across the foundation.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Transparent subtle directional graphic with text 'FOUNDATION TIE'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'அடித்தளத்தை உறுதியாக பிணைக்கும்!'

[SCENE 4: 4.2s - 5.6s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Brick masonry wall frame.
FOREGROUND: Cast RCC vertical column rising along neat wire-cut brick masonry.
CAMERA: Smooth upward vertical tilt movement from ground level to 7-foot height, 28mm lens.
ACTION: Camera pans up following the continuous concrete vertical column linking bottom beam to top beam level.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Vertical dotted line HUD overlay with text 'COLUMN LINK'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'தூண்கள் வழியாக இணைக்கப்பட்டு...'

[SCENE 5: 5.6s - 7.0s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Window/Door frame opening level (7 ft high).
FOREGROUND: Reinforced concrete lintel beam spanning across a door frame opening.
CAMERA: Eye-level shot focused on the horizontal lintel concrete beam, crisp daylight illumination.
ACTION: Natural light highlights the rough wood shuttering texture of the newly stripped lintel beam.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Small white callout label '2. LINTEL BEAM'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'மேலே உள்ள லிண்டல் பீம்...'

[SCENE 6: 7.0s - 8.4s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Window lintel level.
FOREGROUND: Experienced Tamil construction worker putting red wire-cut brick on mortar bed right on top of the lintel beam.
BACKGROUND: Open air behind frame, natural site atmosphere.
CAMERA: Tight medium shot, 50mm portrait perspective, natural depth of field.
ACTION: Mason carefully sets brick in place over the beam using a wooden trowel.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Short text overlay 'WALL LOAD BEARER'.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'ஜன்னல் சுமையைத் தாங்கும்!'

[SCENE 7: 8.4s - 10.0s]
LOCATION/SETTING: Overall building facade under construction.
FOREGROUND: Full front elevation view showing integrated plinth beams and lintel beams clearly.
CAMERA: Low-angle wide shot, slow backward gimbal tracking.
ACTION: Smooth pull-back highlighting the complete structural stability of the house.
OVERLAY GRAPHIC: Subtle green check mark icon overlay, small white text overlay 'OliveTree Builders'. NO full-screen logo card; real footage stays visible throughout.
AUDIO/VO: Tamil Voiceover: 'பலமான வீட்டிற்கு இரண்டுமே அவசியம்!'

CONTINUITY & STYLE RULES:
- Consistent real site in Coimbatore across all scenes: wire-cut bricks, red earth soil, bright natural sunlight.
- Real live-action footage look (90%+ photorealistic), no 3D animation, no glossy CGI, no cartoon characters, no white screen explainers.
- Overlays limited strictly to simple HUD lines, callout text boxes, and small check mark graphic.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Do not render cartoon, 3D render, CGI animation, flat vector art, white background explainer, fake glossy city, floating buildings, non-Tamil Nadu architecture, unrealistic saturated colors, artificial lens flare, full-screen end card, presenter talking to camera, camera crew, religious symbols.
